context: 4.1 The abc-conjecture and the Number-Theoretic Hypothesis 1.11 Oesterlé and Masser’s abc conjecture [75, Conjecture 3] claims the following. ▶ Conjecture 4.1 (abc conjecture). For every ε > 0 there exists a constant κε > 0 such that for all nonzero coprime integers a, b, c satisfying a + b + c = 0, we have max(|a|, |b|, |c|) ≤ κε rad(abc)1+ε . The radical rad(abc) is defined as the product of the distinct primes dividing abc, taken with multiplicity one.
